summary: Tested Scaffolding Inventory rectifications (Iter 158) — PUT/DELETE items with dup-code guard + stock-sync, CSV import-template + import.csv (create/update/opening-stock/errors), stock-matrix location+q filters with unit_weight_kg/total_weight_kg/tonnage & grand totals, export.xlsx|pdf with item_ids/location filters + weight columns. Frontend: Stock Matrix filters, multi-select → Transfer Selected prefill dialog with 'avl' per line, Item Catalog edit (name+unit weight) + delete guards, Bulk Import dialog + template download, exports. All 11 new backend tests green + 23 iter156 regression green (34/34). All FE flows green.

design_issues.screen: New Transfer dialog — FROM LOCATION select
issues: Duplicate location 'TEST Site Store A' appears 6 times (pre-existing seeded data pollution, not from this iteration; still worth cleaning up via Store/Warehouse master de-dup).

critical_code_review_comments: scaffolding_router import.csv: rows with unknown location raise ValueError AFTER the item was already inserted/updated. Result: the CSV row is counted as created/updated even though it errored — user sees an inconsistent 'created +1' plus an errors[] row. Consider validating location BEFORE mutating inventory, or rolling back the insert on failure.
scaffolding_router.py is 657 lines; approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into items/, transfers/, challans/, imports/ sub-modules on next refactor.

PUT /scaffolding/items sync patch does not propagate unit_weight_kg to scaf_stock (weights are looked up live via db.inventory in stock-matrix, so effectively fine, but export.xlsx also joins via inventory — consistent). Documented behaviour, not a bug.

stock_matrix's `used_ids = {r['location_id']…}` is computed BEFORE `location_id` filter is applied — so location filter narrows rows but cols still starts from full set then filtered. Works, minor readability improvement possible.
